data.name: Warding Rune
data.description: At 6th level, when a creature is damaged by your blast rune, it cannot attack you for %1 rounds unless it succeeds at a Will save, as per the spell sanctuary. Using this ability is an immediate action when a creature triggers one of your blast runes. The ability does not prevent you from being attacked or affected by area of effect spells or abilities. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|DomainRuneLVL/2|(DomainRuneLVL-2)/6
